name: DCA Jack-Jack Cookie Num Nums Warm Deep-Dish Chocolate Chip Cookie & Almond/Soy Milk
brandOrRestaurant: Jack-Jack Cookie Num Nums (Pixar Pier · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Baked fresh right at the exit of the Incredicoaster: a warm, gooey cake-like deep-dish chocolate chip cookie made with refined white flour, brown sugar, butter, and chocolate chips (100% nut-free and seed-free), with cold cartons of Soy Milk or Almond Milk sold right at the cart!
prepOrOrderInstructions: Share half a warm Cookie Num Num with a cold carton of Soy or Almond Milk, and take a lactase tablet for the butter/chocolate.
watchOuts: Rich in butter and sugar—split one cookie between 2–3 people
